c74object.name: ambitap.vmic~
c74object.digest: Extract a mono directional signal from a higher-order ambisonics bus
c74object.description: Extract a mono directional signal from a higher-order ambisonics bus. Cardioid at order 1, narrower beams at higher orders. Order is a creation argument.

attribute.name: azimuth
attribute.description: Look-direction azimuth in radians. 0 = front, pi/2 = left.

attribute.name: elevation
attribute.description: Look-direction elevation in radians. 0 = horizon, pi/2 = zenith.

attribute.name: max_re
attribute.digest: Apply per-order max-rE weighting to smooth sidelobes
attribute.description: Apply per-order max-rE weighting to smooth sidelobes.
